cohort: The study included 1874 children at increased risk for type 1 diabetes who were followed from birth.
finding: Thyroid autoimmunity and high TPOAb levels were more common in girls, whereas in boys, there was a strong association and correlation between levels of thyroid and islet autoantibodies, suggesting that the risk for thyroid disease in boys may be linked to concomitant islet autoimmunity.
